title: Which club will sign Manor Solomon from Tottenham Hotspur during the summer 2026 transfer window?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by the clubs involved or reliable contemporaneous news reporting confirming Solomon's completed transfer from Tottenham Hotspur during the summer 2026 transfer window.

Spurs have told Solomon he is not in their plans, he wants to leave, and Spurs must shed non-homegrown players to meet squad rules (football.london, Jul 19).
